title: StressLess: A Mixed-Methods Study on Acceptance and Adherence to a Blended Care Stress Management Intervention for University Students
summary: The research project "StressLess" focuses on acceptance and adherence, as well as on reducing stress and promoting healthy habits among students. In recent years, the proportion of students reporting increased stress has nearly doubled. Chronic stress can not only affect mental and physical well-being, but also reduce academic performance. Therefore, the blended care intervention StressLess was developed. It combines digital self-learning modules with accompanying group sessions to combine the advantages of internet- and mobile-based interventions (IMI), such as flexibility and location-independent use, with the motivational and supportive aspects of face-to-face (F2F) counseling. This integration is intended to increase participant acceptance and adherence and promote sustainable transfer into everyday student life. The study examines how students perceive the program, how satisfied they are with its content, and whether their stress levels are reduced after participating. It also analyzes how regularly the modules are used and whether healthy habits can be established. Supplementary interviews identify factors that facilitate or hinder participation. The program comprises four digital modules with content on stress management, relaxation, and positive psychology, as well as two accompanied group sessions via video conference at the beginning and end of the program. Participants learn how to better cope with stressful situations, relax, and develop healthy long-term routines. The results of the study will contribute to the further development of StressLess and other blended care interventions. The results will also form the basis for the permanent, low-threshold integration of the program into the support services offered by the Technical University of Munich.

interventions.name: The blended intervention, consisting of the internet- and mobile-based intervention (IMI; 4 modules), embedded in two face-to-face (F2F) group sessions via Zoom from the TUM Center for Study and Teaching at the beginning and end of the intervention (F2F – IMI – F2F).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Student status (Technical University of Munich)
Sufficient knowledge of German
Consent to participate in the study
Exclusion criteria:
No student status (Technical University of Munich)
No sufficient knowledge of German
No consent to participate in the study
